context.label: GitHub Actions native ARM64 benchmark comparison
context.precision: Parsed from generated SVG tooltip labels at their exported precision. Raw harness result rows are archived; individual timed samples and confidence intervals are not retained.
context.notes: One full make bench-compare execution on a shared native ARM64 CI runner with 4 available vCPUs. The 8/16-worker cases oversubscribe those CPUs. Comparisons with x86_64 also reflect different hardware and toolchains; they do not isolate an architecture effect.
context.compilerNote: Rust and Go were compiled for native ARM64. GOTOOLCHAIN=local prevented automatic Go switching; archived go version -m output confirms Go 1.25.0 for both reader and writer.
